description: Use this when the user needs to upload an MP4, MOV, or WebM video for a Freebeat lip-sync workflow from an attachment, local file path, or public HTTPS url. Provide exactly one of file, file_path, or url. Returns a video_url for generate_lip_sync_video. Does not generate a new clip. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

file_path.description: Local MP4, MOV, or WebM file path, up to 100 MB. Not available on the hosted server.

url.description: Public HTTPS url of an MP4, MOV, or WebM file, up to 100 MB.

name: upload_video

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.
